summary.en: The name is stated first: a crosshair draws itself, the name presses in letter by letter with a glint under each, a kicker types itself, and the lockup holds a full second before lifting away.
summary.zh: 先立名号：准星描画，名字逐字压印、字底闪过强调色短划，副标打字机打出，整组静止满一秒后上浮消散。

fits: The first beat of an opening that names the product before any of it is shown; a quiet lockup.
notFor: High-energy openings (it starts low on purpose); names longer than two words; repeated mid-film titles.

overlaps.note: a title entering unit by unit with six ways to travel; name-stamp is the whole first-beat lockup (crosshair, press, kicker, hold, exit)

intent.en: Give the viewer the name to remember before anything of the product is shown: quiet, pressed like ink, with one complete still moment.
intent.zh: 在任何产品画面出现之前先让观众看清并记住名字：安静、像墨一样压印，有一个完整的静止时刻。

content.en: The product name (up to 2 words; en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7) and an optional kicker line (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 12).
content.zh: 产品名（最多两个词；英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字）和一行可选副标（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 12）。

fits.zh: 开场第一拍，在展示产品之前先立名号；安静的落版。

notFor.zh: 高能量开场（它故意低起步）；超过两个词的名字；片中反复出现的标题。

pairs.note: a louder second beat that takes the name into the product

en: The full-second hold belongs to the name's lockup; do not copy it onto ordinary title or content cards.
Keep the opening low; a showy first beat leaves the film no room to climb.
zh: 满一秒的静止是给名号落定的；别照搬到普通字卡或内容卡上。
开场能量要低；第一拍就炫技，后面没有爬升空间。
